domain: finite linear-sRGB RGB [0,1]^3, fixed EV=0, HNCS 5500 K legacy/standard; FFCS direct EV=0; optional HNCS then FFCS chain
output: display-linear sRGB float; supplementary encoded-sRGB float metrics with no integer quantization

method.interpolation: CPU float32 trilinear plus selected tetrahedral comparison, R-major B-fast grid; half stored nodes promoted to float32 before interpolation
method.spatial: FFCS grain=0 and sharp=0 in tool-private contexts only; full serial production API matches extracted pointwise oracle bit for bit on 1000 colors per FFCS look
method.shapers: linear or encoded-sRGB coordinates, both evaluate the same linear-sRGB input domain
method.timing: 3 bake calls; lookup warmup plus 3 timed calls; excludes context/asset load, grid generation, quantization, coordinate shaping, allocation, I/O and GPU upload. CPU reference only; not GPU or device measurements
method.metric: max absolute channel; p95/p99 of per-pixel max absolute RGB channel; per-channel RMSE. DeltaE76 uses standard linear-sRGB to XYZ D65 and Lab D65, no chromatic adaptation; diagnostic only, not DeltaE2000 or a universal visibility threshold. All normalized [0,1].
method.limits: Synthetic holdouts are not a formal worst-case bound or photographic/camera validation. No GPU filtering arithmetic or camera-match claim.
